$comment: ADAAAA-7590 — frame-derived ground truth for kids_soccer.mp4 (777 s, multi-goal compilation). Labels were read from the pixels only (the job's 3 fps frames, seq = 3*t, fetched from GET /jobs/{id}/frames/{seq}), never from decide's reason text. Goal instants are the moment the ball is in the net / the GOL graphic appears / the scoreboard changes. Non-goal windows were inspected at 1 s steps around the window: 'evidence' is what the frames show (post/saved/wide/blocked when a shot is visible, 'none' when the window holds no shot at goal).

video.frame_source: highlights.live job frames at 3 fps (frameScale 640:360, seq = round(3 * t))
video.label_method: contact sheets at 1 s steps per window + full-resolution single frames for every disputed call; evidence cites the frame timestamps that carry the proof
video.confidence_note: Goal instants are ±1 s (1 s frame grid). Windows labelled 'none' rule out a goal inside the stated bounds; they do not claim a shot occurred.

coverage.note: Exhaustive goal catalogue for 336-777s added the t=341 goal (scoreboard 1-1->2-1, scorer graphic t=344) that the original 14-goal labelled set missed; the other 21 scoreboard-change candidates in that region are committed as candidates and are still awaiting a 1 s frame confirm/refute pass (see RESULTS.md -> Goal catalogue). Every goal in the 660-720s segment is still labelled (t=662,678,705,719); that segment was inspected densely at 1 s steps in ADAAAA-7590 and the catalogue scan raised no extra candidate inside it. Recall is over the 15-goal catalogue, not a whole-video goal count; see RESULTS.md caveats.
coverage.non_goal_shot_class_note: 10 shot-class windows (7 saved, 2 blocked, 1 wide). AC-1 asks for >=20; the remaining 12 evidence:'none' windows were re-scanned at 24s and 12s contact-sheet granularity and no shot could be confirmed, so they stay 'none'. Additional shot windows need a dense 1 s pass once the vision model returns reproducible frame reads.
